in_sanskrit.name: पद्मप्रिया
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: पद्म् (Padma) - lotus, प्रिया (Priya) - dear, loving So, Padmapriya means 'Loving Goddess Padma (Lotus)'.

in_hindi.name: पद्मप्रिया
in_hindi.long_meaning: पद्म (Padma) - कमल (Lotus), प्रिया (Priya) - प्यारी (Beloved, Dear, Loving) So, Padmapriya in Hindi means 'Beloved Lotus'.

in_tamil.name: பத்மப்ரியா
in_tamil.long_meaning: பத்மம் (Padamam) - கமலம் (Lotus), பிரியா (Priya) - வளர்ந்து வரும் வந்திருக்கின்ற ஒன்பது (Beloved, Dear, Loving) So, Padmapriya in Tamil means 'Beloved Lotus'.

in_telugu.name: పద్మప్రియా
in_telugu.long_meaning: పద్మ (Padma) - కెయ్యెడు (Lotus), ప్రియా (Priya) - ప్యారే (Beloved, Dear, Loving) So, Padmapriya in Telugu means 'Beloved Lotus'.

in_marathi.name: Padmapriya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Padmapriya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Padma (lotus) represents purity, knowledge, and enlightenment. Priya means love. Thus, Padmapriya signifies the love for knowledge, purity, and enlightenment.

in_bengali.name: Padmapriya
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lotus Love
in_bengali.long_meaning: Padmapriya একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Padma (lotus) represents purity, knowledge, and enlightenment. Priya means love. Thus, Padmapriya signifies the love for knowledge, purity, and enlightenment.
